subject: Route to Production: BlueFort pilot milestones & decision checkpoints
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <h.li@bluefort.com>, Marcus Wong <marcus.w@bluefort.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Route to Production: BlueFort pilot milestones & decision checkpoints

Hannah / Marcus — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed route-to-production plan so we all have the same set of milestones and owners. Please confirm or flag changes by end of day Tue (Apr 27) so we can lock dates with engineering and procurement.

Key pain points you described:
- Latency spikes during batch digest windows causing timeouts for customer-facing features (esp. 95th/99th pct).
- Unpredictable monthly spend from the legacy on-demand inference stack.
- Data residency / segmentation requirements for PII-enriched requests.

Stated goals for the pilot:
- Validate infra that keeps 99th percentile latency < 300ms for typical request mix.
- Pilot with ~2k monthly active users; measure cost per 1k tokens and production runbook.
- Ensure data handling meets BlueFort compliance standards for EU data and retention.

Proposed milestones (first pass):
1) Security questionnaire & gap list — owner: BlueFort security (target: 2027-05-06)
2) Pilot environment provisioned (VPC + KMS scoped) — owner: Ben Carter / Redwood infra (target: 2027-05-12)
3) Integration & prompt tuning (data + evals) — owner: Monica Patel / BlueFort engineering (target: 2027-05-17)
4) Pilot run (4 weeks) — owner: BlueFort product + Redwood support (start: 2027-05-17, end: 2027-06-14)
5) Executive review & procurement decision — owner: BlueFort execs (target: 2027-06-21)

Decision process we discussed:
- Security signoff -> procurement term sheet -> legal SLA sign-off -> exec approval.
- Procurement will confirm budget and PO terms after security artifacts and SLA draft.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestone tracker) and Initial_SLA_Draft.pdf (starts with standard Redwood terms; legal will need to redline).

Action items for BlueFort: confirm security contact who will own the questionnaire and confirm exec decision timeframe.
Action items for Redwood: Ben will scope infra provisioning effort & Monica will prepare onboarding checklist and sample evals.

Thanks — I’ll drop a formal milestone table into the tracker and update when I hear back.

—
Grace O'Connor
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side:

- I will own the internal project timeline (product). Marcus Wong (cc’d) will be our procurement lead — he will need the SLA draft and an estimate for committed spend.
- Security will be led by Lina Park (security@bluefort.com); she requested SOC 2 evidence and a short architecture diagram showing where data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
- Our execs are aiming to review pilot results the week of Jun 21; procurement indicated the final PO could be issued in the week after exec approval (exceptions possible).

We can get you Lina’s contact and a copy of our standard vendor questionnaire by EOD Tue (Apr 27). Regarding dates, May 17 start for the pilot looks feasible for the product & engineering teams.

One ask on costing: can you provide a ballpark committed-pricing scenario for a 3-month pilot (monthly VM/GPU + per-token) so procurement has numbers to work with? A range is fine.

Hannah

Hannah / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal sync and your replies, attaching the updated milestone table and confirming owners/dates below. Please confirm acceptance (reply-all OK) so BlueFort procurement / security can proceed with their internal steps.

Finalized milestone table (owners & dates):
- Security questionnaire submitted to Redwood (owner: Lina Park / BlueFort) — due 2027-05-06
- Architecture & dataflow diagram (owner: Monica Patel / Redwood) — due 2027-05-07
- Pilot infra provisioned (VPC + KMS + pilot cluster) (owner: Ben Carter / Redwood) — due 2027-05-12
- Integration & tuning (owner: Monica Patel / Redwood + BlueFort eng) — integration complete by 2027-05-17
- Pilot run (4 weeks) (owner: BlueFort product + Redwood support) — 2027-05-17 to 2027-06-14
- Pilot metrics review & exec summary (owner: Hannah Li / BlueFort) — 2027-06-18
- Executive decision and procurement PO (owner: BlueFort execs & Marcus Wong) — target 2027-06-21

Notes / clarifications:
- Decision criteria: meeting latency SLOs (99th % < 300ms), demonstrable cost per 1k tokens within the committed range, and no unresolved security blockers.
- If procurement needs an earlier PO, we can offer a short soft-commitment (non-binding) to reserve capacity for a 2-week window; Ben, please include that option in the pricing sheet.
- Docs: attached "Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx" has the tracker; "Initial_SLA_Draft.pdf" contains the baseline terms.

Next steps (for BlueFort):
1) Please reply-all to confirm the milestone dates and Lina’s contact for the questionnaire.
2) Marcus — if you can confirm the procurement decision gate and any internal budget cadence that would change the dates, call that out.

If I don’t hear objections, we’ll treat this as the agreed mutual plan and proceed to lock infra dates.
